ledger.x: 1835: northern chiefs declare the independence of New Zealand at Waitangi. the United Tribes declared independence on 28 October 1835 by signing the Declaration of Independence, which Busby had drafted (page, closely paraphrased; British Resident James Busby; the flag had been chosen on 20 March 1834 and gazetted in…
1840: Britain declares sovereignty over the North Island.

certainty.note: A confederation of chiefs' lands with no surveyed boundary; Northland is a stand-in.
